note: The Veth builds (WP17, owner 2026-10-17: Lean/Average/Heavy plus one more at each end). Average is the owner's MetaHuman unchanged. A build is made by the MetaHuman Creator's own solver (asset_work/metahuman/tools/ue_build_variants.py): every girth and breadth the Creator measures times girth_factor, every length and the height held, applied to the owner's body as the solver's change; the torso-profile calibration (build_calibrate.py) keeps the front-view shape within a few percent of Average. The extremes ship only if every garment passes the clipping gate on them. mpfb: MakeHuman macro steps (weight, muscle) for the production (MPFB) family's build models (mpfb_specs.py). arm_splay_deg: the build's pose offset - upper arms turned out from the trunk after the clips (Art/BuildPose.cs), so the arm swing clears the build's own sides.
